decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 25 May 2006, demolition of existing rear store and erection of single storey rear extension and the erection of a rear dormer roof extension incorporating the installation of two roof lights to the front roof slope, as shown on drawing number SV(0) 101 - 104 & LD(0) 101 - 104, received 25 May 2006, is less than 15% of the entire gross floor area of the existing dwelling, so therefore was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of demolition of existing rear store and erection of single storey rear extension (5.3m wide, 4.15m deep & 3.5m high), the erection of a rear dormer roof extension (3.7m deep, 3.35m wide & 2.65m high) and incorporating the installation of two roof lights to the front roof slope, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A, Class B and class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
Condition : 3 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of the existing rear store and erection of a part single storey rear extension and a rear roof extension incorporating two rooflights to the front roof slope of the house.
